method: Official primary pages inspected with web tool; targeted contract audit, not exhaustive re-verification of every earlier pinned product claim. No project execution or metric certification.

sources.finding: Official product documentation lists codebase understanding, feature building, bug fixing, review and cloud agents; local-only contrast corrected.
Official current page identifies default Builtin engine as SQLite-based with keyword/vector/hybrid search. Preserve file content versus index distinction.
MEMORY.md startup load is first 200 lines or 25KB, whichever first; version-sensitive limit retained.
Checkpointer thread state versus cross-thread store distinction retained; memory saver not restart durable.
initialize and initialized precede negotiated feature use; corrected missing handshake.
Authorization optional; HTTP contract and stdio differ. Corrected universal OAuth implication.
Trace context injection/extraction supports causal relation; trace is not durable business authority.
EventSource reconnection carries Last-Event-ID; service must supply history, no automatic durable replay.
Coverage is execution coverage, not business correctness; retain branch and exception distinction.
Modern per-request metadata removes initialize handshake; staged introduction explicitly distinguishes the 2025-11-25 flow from 2026-07-28.

projectEvidence: reviews/noteweave-project-verification/FACT-MATRIX.md; Java 17 declaration retained as declaration only.
